Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Keep this rendering exactly as in the attached image — the same finish, line, shading, skin and colour treatment.

LEFT HAND: her own left hand is in PROP.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

Her element — chlorine: a pale yellow-green gas that is poison in a cloud and cleanliness in a drop — the clarity of a swimming pool, bleached white linen snapping in the wind, the sharp clean smell; the other half of sea salt; it disinfects, bleaches and purifies — may show in the outfit's details, motifs or small accessories.
